system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

The project page describes the asset as a master table merged from country-level CSV/Shapefile ingests; it also contains a mild source inconsistency about whether 92 or 93 countries are available in the curated release.

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Inspect the exact property names for wealth score and error before aggregation, and treat the asset as a static socioeconomic feature table rather than a time series.
